name: ForLoop_MAKEARRAY
formula: =LAMBDA(start,end,func,[step],LET(s, IF(ISOMITTED(step), 1, step), c_count, COLUMNS(func(start)), row_count, (end - start) / s + 1, MAKEARRAY(row_count, c_count, LAMBDA(r,c, LET(i, start + (r - 1) * s, INDEX(func(i), 1, c))))))
comment: For loop. 'func' shall be a lambda function LAMBDA(i,output) to describe the actions to be taken in the for loop. Last Update 2025-08-01.
